ORC — a race timed to the millisecond is scored on elapsed times to the second

ORC Rating Systems 401.2: the boat's elapsed time is translated to seconds, calculations are made, and the result is rounded to the nearest second (12345.5 = 12346). The ORC Race Management Guide §4.5 records finishes to the nearest second; boats whose corrected times are then equal tie under RRS A7.

Scoring system: ORC
